name: Disney's All-Star Movies Resort
theme: Bright, playful buildings decorated with giant icons from classic Disney films.
transport: Buses to all four parks and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Value resort in the Animal Kingdom area. In 2026 a Standard Room ran about $153 to $311 a night at full price, tax included. Preferred rooms ran about $194 to $359, depending on the dates. Tax at the All-Star resorts is 13.5%.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Buses to all four theme parks, the water parks and Disney Springs. There is no Skyliner, monorail or boat from this resort.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard and Preferred rooms are the same layout, about 260 sq ft [verify], and sleep up to 4 adults. Most have 1 queen bed and 1 queen-size table bed; some have a king instead. Preferred rooms are closer to Cinema Hall.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families watching the nightly rate who can live with a food court and a bus. A weaker pick if you want a sit-down restaurant, or if construction noise through January 2027 would bother you.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: World Premiere Food Court and Silver Screen Spirits Pool Bar. No table-service restaurant on site.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Fantasia Pool is the main pool, with a kiddie pool nearby. Duck Pond Pool is the second pool, officially listed at 105,438 gallons.

heads: Official pages say guest rooms at All-Star Movies are under planned refurbishment through January 2027. Guests may see or hear construction and may need to use alternate paths. The resort remains open.

name: Disney's All-Star Music Resort
theme: Music-themed buildings with oversized instruments, plus family suites for bigger groups.
transport: Buses to all four parks and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Value resort in the Animal Kingdom area. In 2026 a Standard Room ran about $152 to $311 a night at full price, tax included. Preferred rooms ran about $199 to $364. Family Suites ran about $375 to $731, depending on the dates. Tax at the All-Star resorts is 13.5%.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Buses to all four theme parks, the water parks and Disney Springs. There is no Skyliner, monorail or boat from this resort.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard and Preferred rooms sleep 4, about 260 sq ft [verify], with 1 queen bed and 1 queen-size table bed. Family Suites sleep 6, about 520 sq ft [verify], with 1 queen bed and 2 queen-size pull-down beds, plus a second bathroom and a kitchenette.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families of five or six who want a Value-rate suite, and smaller parties who want All-Star pricing. A weaker pick if you want a sit-down restaurant at the hotel.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Intermission Food Court and Singing Spirits Pool Bar. No table-service restaurant on site.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Calypso Pool is the main pool, officially listed at 251,418 gallons, with a kiddie pool behind Melody Hall. Piano Pool is the quieter leisure pool, listed at 106,036 gallons.

name: Disney's All-Star Sports Resort
theme: Sports-themed buildings with supersized balls, helmets and courts.
transport: Buses to all four parks and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Value resort in the Animal Kingdom area. In 2026 a Standard Room ran about $149 to $311 a night at full price, tax included. Preferred rooms ran about $187 to $354, depending on the dates. Tax at the All-Star resorts is 13.5%.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Buses to all four theme parks, the water parks and Disney Springs. There is no Skyliner, monorail or boat from this resort.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard and Preferred rooms are the same layout, about 260 sq ft [verify], and sleep up to 4 adults, with 1 queen bed and 1 queen-size table bed. Preferred rooms are closer to Stadium Hall. There are no family suites at this resort.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families watching the nightly rate who can live with a food court and a bus. A weaker pick if you need to sleep five or six in one room, or if you want a sit-down restaurant at the hotel.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: End Zone Food Court and Grandstand Spirits Pool Bar. No table-service restaurant on site.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Surfboard Bay Pool is the main pool, officially listed at 242,471 gallons, with a kiddie pool behind Stadium Hall. Grand Slam Pool is the second pool.

name: Disney's Pop Century Resort
theme: A walk through 20th-century pop culture, decade by decade, across the lake from Art of Animation.
transport: Disney Skyliner gondolas to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Value resort in the Wide World of Sports area. In 2026 a Standard Room ran about $213 to $404 a night at full price, tax included, depending on dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Skyliner gondola to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios, with a quick change at the Caribbean Beach hub. Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, Disney Springs and the water parks.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: About 260 sq ft [verify], sleeping up to 4 adults. Every room is the same: 1 queen bed plus a queen pull-down bed that folds into a table, or 1 king. The four room categories only change location and view.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Budget-minded families with young kids who want easy EPCOT and Hollywood Studios days. Tight for four adults, and not the pick if the pool or resort dining is the point of your trip.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Everything POP food court for breakfast, lunch and dinner, plus Petals Pool Bar. There's no table-service restaurant on site.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Three pools: the flower-shaped Hippy Dippy Pool with a kiddie splash area, plus the smaller Bowling and Computer pools. No hot tubs.

heads: The Skyliner is closed Jan 24–30, 2027 (buses fill in), and on EPCOT Extended Evening Hours nights the Skyliner route to Pop Century stops running early.

hero.alt: The giant Duncan Imperial yo-yo icon in front of a guest-room building at Disney's Pop Century Resort, with Hourglass Lake visible at right.

name: Disney's Art of Animation Resort
theme: Themed to animated films, with most rooms set up as family suites.
transport: Disney Skyliner gondolas to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Value resort in the Wide World of Sports area, next to Pop Century. In 2026 a Little Mermaid Standard Room ran about $251 to $443 a night at full price, tax included. Family Suites ran about $519 to $992, depending on the theme and dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Skyliner gondola to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios, with a change at the Caribbean Beach hub. The station is on the Generation Gap Bridge and is shared with Pop Century. Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, Disney Springs and the water parks leave from Animation Hall.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Little Mermaid rooms are about 277 sq ft [verify] and sleep up to 4 adults, with 1 king bed or 2 queen beds. Family Suites in the Cars, Finding Nemo and Lion King sections are about 565 sq ft [verify], sleep up to 6, and have two bathrooms, a kitchenette, a queen bed, a double sleeper sofa and a double pull-down bed.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families of five or six who want suite space and two bathrooms at a Value price, especially if EPCOT and Hollywood Studios are high on the list. The Little Mermaid rooms suit smaller parties on a tighter budget, but they are a longer walk from the lobby.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Landscape of Flavors is the food court in Animation Hall, open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The Drop Off pool bar sits by the Big Blue Pool. There's no table-service restaurant on site; Everything POP at Pop Century is a walk across the bridge.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Three pools: the Big Blue Pool in the Finding Nemo courtyard, which Disney calls the largest hotel pool at Walt Disney World, plus the Cozy Cone Pool in the Cars courtyard and the Flippin' Fins Pool in the Little Mermaid courtyard.

heads: The Skyliner is closed Jan 24–30, 2027 (buses fill in), and on EPCOT Extended Evening Hours nights the Skyliner route to Art of Animation stops running early.

hero.alt: Desert-colored guest buildings in the Cars courtyard at Disney's Art of Animation Resort, beside the Ornament Valley sign.

pool.alt: The Big Blue Pool in the Finding Nemo courtyard at Disney's Art of Animation Resort, with the blue-and-white guest buildings beyond the fence.

name: Disney's Caribbean Beach Resort
theme: Colorful Caribbean island villages around a lake, and the central hub of the Skyliner.
transport: Disney Skyliner gondolas to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Moderate resort with a Skyliner station on property. In 2026 a Standard Location room ran about $310 to $523 a night at full price, tax included. Preferred Location rooms ran about $396 to $627, and King rooms ran about $374 to $590, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Skyliner gondolas to EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, and Pop Century / Art of Animation. Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs. Official pages say the Skyliner is closed January 24–30, 2027, and January 24–February 2, 2028, with buses filling in.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard and Preferred rooms sleep 4, about 300 sq ft [verify], with 2 queen beds. Some rooms also have a child-size pull-down bed. King rooms sleep 2. Preferred rooms are closer to Centertown.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Anyone who wants the Skyliner at a Moderate rate, and families who can live with a spread-out village layout. A weaker pick if Magic Kingdom is your main park, or if you don't want to walk.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Centertown Market and Spyglass Grill are quick service. Sebastian's Bistro is table service. Banana Cabana is the pool bar at Fuentes del Morro.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Fuentes del Morro Pool is the main pool, with two slides (including one 102 feet long) and a 12-person spa. There are also 5 leisure pools, one in each village.

heads: Official pages say the Skyliner will be closed for routine refurbishment January 24 through 30, 2027, and January 24 through February 2, 2028. Complimentary bus service will be available.

name: Disney's Coronado Springs Resort
theme: Spanish and Mexican-inspired buildings around a large lake, including the Gran Destino Tower.
transport: Buses to all four parks and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Moderate resort with village rooms and Gran Destino Tower. In 2026 a Village Standard Location room ran about $294 to $470 a night at full price, tax included. Preferred village rooms ran about $426 to $573. Tower Resort View rooms ran about $376 to $670, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Buses to all four theme parks, the water parks and Disney Springs. There is no Skyliner, monorail or boat from this resort.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Village rooms with 2 queens sleep 4, about 314 sq ft [verify]. King rooms sleep 2. Tower rooms are a separate product, with Resort View, Water View and Club Access categories. Suites are also offered. Tower room sizes are not confirmed [verify].

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families who want Moderate pricing and more dining than a typical Moderate, or guests who want a Tower or club room. A weaker pick if you want the Skyliner or a compact layout, or if convention-center construction through late 2027 would bother you.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Toledo – Tapas, Steak & Seafood in the Tower, plus Maya Grill, Rix Sports Bar & Grill, Three Bridges Bar & Grill and Café Rix [verify the current full dining list].

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: The Lost City of Cibola Pool at the Dig Site is the main pool, with a 123-foot slide and a 22-person hot tub. There are also 3 leisure pools in the Casitas, Ranchos and Cabanas.

heads: Official pages say the convention center is under planned refurbishment from August 10, 2026, through late September 2027. The El Centro Corridor and surrounding areas have related work. Guests may see or hear construction.

name: Disney's Port Orleans Resort – French Quarter
theme: A compact resort styled after the French Quarter of New Orleans.
transport: Buses to all four parks and Disney Springs
Boat to Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: A compact Moderate resort next to Port Orleans Riverside. In 2026 a Standard Location room ran about $322 to $483 a night at full price, tax included. Preferred Location rooms ran about $356 to $557, and King rooms ran about $375 to $578, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Sassagoula River Cruise boat to Disney Springs and to Port Orleans Riverside. Buses to all four theme parks and the water parks.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard and Preferred rooms sleep 4, about 314 sq ft [verify], with 2 queen beds. King rooms sleep 2. Preferred rooms are closer to the lobby, the food court and the boat dock.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: People who want a smaller Moderate with a boat to Disney Springs. A weaker pick if you need a fifth (child) sleeper or a Royal Guest Room — those are on the Riverside side.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Sassagoula Floatworks and Food Factory is the food court. Scat Cat's Club – Café is scheduled to reopen in December 2026; the Lounge is scheduled to reopen in January 2027.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Doubloon Lagoon is the main pool, with the 51-foot Scales sea-serpent slide. Guests can also use Ol' Man Island at Port Orleans Riverside.

heads: Official pages say Scat Cat's Club – Café and Scat Cat's Club – Lounge closed for refurbishment beginning October 6, 2026. The café is expected to reopen in December 2026, and the lounge in January 2027.

name: Disney's Port Orleans Resort – Riverside
theme: Southern riverside mansions and bayou-style buildings along a winding river.
transport: Buses to all four parks and Disney Springs
Boat to Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: A larger Moderate resort next to Port Orleans French Quarter. In 2026 a Standard Location room ran about $322 to $483 a night at full price, tax included. 5th Sleeper rooms ran about $361 to $541. Preferred rooms ran about $414 to $613, and Royal Guest Rooms ran about $408 to $579, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Sassagoula River Cruise boat to Disney Springs and to Port Orleans French Quarter. Buses to all four theme parks and the water parks.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Most rooms sleep 4, about 314 sq ft [verify], with 2 queen beds. Alligator Bayou 5th Sleeper rooms add a child-size pull-down bed (still listed as sleeping 4 adults). Royal Guest Rooms are a more themed category in Magnolia Bend. King rooms sleep 2.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families who want two queens, maybe a child-size pull-down bed, a table-service restaurant and a boat to Disney Springs. A weaker pick if you want a compact layout, or if construction through mid-2027 would bother you.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Riverside Mill Food Court and Boatwright's Dining Hall, plus Muddy Rivers at the main pool.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Ol' Man Island is the main pool, with a 95-foot slide, a kiddie pool and a whirlpool spa. There are also 5 leisure pools. Guests can use Doubloon Lagoon at French Quarter too.

heads: Official pages say guest rooms and select public areas are under refurbishment through mid-2027. Guests may see or hear daytime construction, and alternate paths of travel may be in place.

name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge
theme: An African-inspired lodge where many rooms look out over savannas with live animals.
transport: Buses to all four parks and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe resort in the Animal Kingdom area. This guide covers the hotel rooms at Jambo House. In 2026 a Resort View room ran about $508 to $915 a night at full price, tax included. Savanna View rooms ran about $731 to $1,227, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Buses to all four theme parks, Disney Springs and the water parks. There is no monorail, boat or Skyliner from here.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard hotel rooms are about 344 sq ft [verify] and sleep up to 4 adults with 2 queen beds, or up to 2 adults with 1 king bed. Views are Resort (rooftop or parking), Water (the pool) or Savanna. Club Level rooms look over the savanna and include lounge access.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Anyone who wants to watch giraffes and zebras from a balcony, and families who like having Boma and Jiko on site. It is a bus-only resort, so it is a weaker pick if a short ride to Magic Kingdom is the main goal.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Boma is the buffet for breakfast and dinner. Jiko is the table-service dinner restaurant. The Mara is the quick-service spot, open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Sanaa, another table-service restaurant, is a short walk away at Kidani Village.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Uzima Springs Pool at Jambo House is the main pool, at 234,980 gallons, with a 67-foot slide, zero-depth entry and a view of Uzima Savanna. Guests can also use Samawati Springs Pool at Kidani Village, which has a 128-foot slide and the Uwanja Camp splash area.

heads: Jambo House guest rooms are under renovation from May 2026 through January 2027. Disney says you may see or hear construction, and that most amenities remain available.

hero.alt: A giraffe walks the savanna in front of the guest-room balconies at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge.

name: Disney's Beach Club Resort
theme: A breezy New England seaside hotel, sharing a large sand-bottom pool area with the Yacht Club.
transport: Walking paths and Friendship boats to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe resort in the EPCOT area, sharing grounds and Stormalong Bay with Yacht Club. In 2026 a Resort View room ran about $650 to $1,162 a night at full price, tax included. Water View rooms ran about $772 to $1,231, and Deluxe Rooms ran about $836 to $1,318, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Walking path and Friendship boats to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios. The EPCOT Skyliner station is a walk through the International Gateway. Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Resort View and Water View rooms sleep up to 5, about 400 sq ft [verify]. Deluxe Rooms sleep 6 and are larger than a standard room. Club Level rooms include lounge access. Confirm the bed setup if you need a day bed.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Anyone who wants to walk or boat to EPCOT or Hollywood Studios, and families of five who will use Stormalong Bay. A weaker pick if Magic Kingdom is your main park, or if exterior work through late 2027 would bother you.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Cape May Cafe and Beaches & Cream Soda Shop at Beach Club, plus Ale & Compass, Yachtsman Steakhouse and The Market at Ale & Compass at Yacht Club next door.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Stormalong Bay is the shared main pool. There are also 3 leisure pools, including one at Beach Club Villas.

heads: Official pages say Beach Club will have visible exterior maintenance through late 2027, which may impact some views and, at times, require alternate paths during daytime hours. The Skyliner is also closed January 24–30, 2027, and January 24–February 2, 2028, with buses filling in.

name: Disney's BoardWalk Inn
theme: A turn-of-the-century Atlantic seaboard boardwalk on Crescent Lake, with shops and restaurants outside the door.
transport: Walking paths and Friendship boats to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe resort in the EPCOT area. This guide covers the hotel rooms at BoardWalk Inn. In 2026 a Resort View room ran about $686 to $1,185 a night at full price, tax included. Water View rooms ran about $820 to $1,267, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Walking paths and Friendship boats go to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios. Buses serve Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard rooms are often listed around 434 sq ft [verify]. Many sleep up to 5 adults, though the bed setup varies: some rooms have 2 queen beds and a day bed, and others have 2 queens or a king, with or without a day bed. Views are Resort or Water. Club Level rooms include lounge access.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Anyone who wants to walk or take a boat to EPCOT or Hollywood Studios, and people who like having the BoardWalk shops and restaurants outside the door. It is a weaker pick if you need a guaranteed 5-person bed setup, because not every standard room includes a day bed.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: BoardWalk Deli is the quick-service spot. Trattoria al Forno serves breakfast and dinner. Flying Fish is the Signature dinner restaurant. The Cake Bake Shop and other BoardWalk restaurants are a short walk from the hotel.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Luna Park Pool is the main pool, at 184,217 gallons, with a 200-foot slide, a kiddie pool and a whirlpool spa. There are also two quieter leisure pools, often called the Inn Pool and the Villas Pool. Official pages say Luna Park Pool, the Luna Park Crazy Play Area and Leaping Horse Libations will close January 11 through April 2027 for maintenance.

heads: Official Disney pages say the Luna Park Pool, the Luna Park Crazy Play Area and Leaping Horse Libations will be closed for routine maintenance from January 11, 2027, through April 2027. The Inn Pool and the Villas Pool are planned to stay open, and guests may see or hear work during the day.

hero.alt: The Crest O' The Wave building at Disney's BoardWalk Inn at night, with lit guest-room balconies under a wave-shaped roofline.

name: Disney's Contemporary Resort
theme: A modern A-frame tower that the monorail runs right through, a short walk from Magic Kingdom.
transport: Walking path to Magic Kingdom
Monorail to Magic Kingdom and Epcot (Epcot via a transfer at the Transportation and Ticket Center)
Buses to Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe resort in the Magic Kingdom area. This guide covers the hotel rooms in the Main Tower and Garden Wing. In 2026 a Garden Wing Resort View room ran about $638 to $1,137 a night at full price, tax included. Main Tower Theme Park View rooms ran about $960 to $1,518, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: A walking path and the resort monorail both go to Magic Kingdom. The monorail also goes to EPCOT after a transfer at the Transportation and Ticket Center. Boats connect this resort with Wilderness Lodge and Fort Wilderness. Buses serve Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard rooms are often listed around 400 to 437 sq ft [verify] and typically sleep up to 5 adults with 2 queen beds and a day bed. Garden Wing rooms sit next to the Main Tower. Main Tower rooms have Water View or Theme Park View. Club Level rooms include lounge access.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Anyone who wants the shortest walk or monorail ride to Magic Kingdom, and families who need a standard room that can sleep five. It is a weaker pick if you were hoping to avoid construction in 2026 and 2027, or if a quieter, less busy hotel is the goal.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Chef Mickey's is the character buffet for breakfast and dinner. California Grill is the 15th-floor dinner restaurant, with a view of Magic Kingdom. Steakhouse 71 serves breakfast, lunch and dinner. Contempo Cafe is the quick-service spot on the Grand Canyon Concourse.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: The Feature Pool is the main pool, with a 17-foot waterslide. Bay Lake Pool is a quieter leisure pool. There are whirlpool spas, and cabanas may be available to rent.

heads: Refurbishment work is underway in the atrium, on the Main Tower exterior and at Bay Lake Tower, and it is expected to continue through late 2027. Views and some outdoor paths may be affected, and you may see or hear work during the day. [verify current status]

hero.alt: The A-frame tower of Disney's Contemporary Resort, seen from the sandy beach with empty lounge chairs in the foreground.

name: Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa
theme: A Victorian-style seaside hotel on the Seven Seas Lagoon, and Walt Disney World's flagship resort.
transport: Monorail to Magic Kingdom and Epcot (Epcot via a transfer at the Transportation and Ticket Center)
Boat to Magic Kingdom
Walking path to Magic Kingdom
Buses to Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe resort in the Magic Kingdom area, on the Seven Seas Lagoon. In 2026 a Resort View room ran about $832 to $1,370 a night at full price, tax included. Water View rooms ran about $864 to $1,506, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Resort monorail to Magic Kingdom, and to EPCOT with a change at the Transportation and Ticket Center. A boat (the Gold Launch) runs to Magic Kingdom and also serves the Polynesian Village. Buses go to Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard hotel rooms are about 448 sq ft [verify] and sleep up to 5 adults, with 2 queen beds and a day bed, or 1 king bed and a day bed. Most standard view rooms are in the outer buildings. Club Level rooms and suites are a separate set of categories, some of them larger.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families who want monorail or boat access to Magic Kingdom and a lot of dining on site, including a character buffet. Theme Park View rooms look toward the park. It is a Deluxe price at the high end of the scale, so it is not the pick if the nightly rate is the main concern.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: This is one of the biggest dining resorts on property. 1900 Park Fare is the character buffet for breakfast and dinner. Grand Floridian Cafe, Cítricos, Narcoossee's and Victoria & Albert's are table service. Gasparilla Island Grill is the quick-service spot, and Enchanted Rose and Garden View Lounge are the lounges.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: The Beach Pool is the main pool, at 111,261 gallons, with a 181-foot slide, a waterfall, zero-depth entry and a splash area for little kids. The Courtyard Pool is a quieter, heated zero-entry pool behind the main building, with a whirlpool spa.

heads: Renovations continue in select areas, including the porte cochere, through early 2027. Disney says guests may see or hear work during the day or need to take alternate paths.

hero.alt: The wooden boat dock at dusk, with the waterfront restaurant on the left and a guest building at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa ahead.

name: Disney's Polynesian Village Resort
theme: A South Pacific island resort on the Seven Seas Lagoon, looking across the water to Magic Kingdom.
transport: Monorail to Magic Kingdom and Epcot (Epcot via a transfer at the Transportation and Ticket Center)
Boat to Magic Kingdom
Walking path to the Transportation and Ticket Center for the Epcot monorail
Buses to Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe resort in the Magic Kingdom area, on the Seven Seas Lagoon. In 2026 a Resort View room ran about $771 to $1,371 a night at full price, tax included. Water View rooms ran about $876 to $1,446, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Resort monorail to Magic Kingdom, and to EPCOT with a change at the Transportation and Ticket Center. A walking path also leads to the TTC. A boat (the Gold Launch) runs to Magic Kingdom and also serves the Grand Floridian. Buses go to Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard hotel rooms are about 415 sq ft [verify] and sleep up to 5 adults. Most are set up with 2 queen beds and a day bed. Some Resort View rooms have 1 king bed and a day bed, or 2 queen beds. Honeymoon Club Level rooms sleep 2, with 1 king bed.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families who want monorail or boat access to Magic Kingdom, and anyone who cares about on-site dining. Theme Park View rooms look across the lagoon toward the park. It is a Deluxe price, so it is not the pick if you are mainly watching the nightly rate.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: This is a dining resort. 'Ohana serves a character breakfast with Lilo and Stitch, plus a family-style dinner without characters. Kona Cafe is table service for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Capt. Cook's and Chip 'n' Dale's Deli are the quick-service spots, and Pineapple Lanai is the walk-up window for pineapple soft-serve. Trader Sam's Grog Grotto is the themed bar.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: The Lava Pool is the main pool, with a volcano, a waterfall, a 142-foot slide and zero-depth entry. The Oasis Pool is a quieter garden pool. Guests can also use the Cove Pool and Moana's Voyage splash area at Island Tower.

heads: Disney has listed construction on the front drive and bus area from May 2025 through 2026, and exterior maintenance starting Jan 15, 2026, that may block lagoon views from 'Ohana. Restaurants, pools and amenities were planned to stay open. [verify if this work is still underway]

hero.alt: A garden path and lit tiki torch lead toward the longhouses at Disney's Polynesian Village Resort.

room.alt: A standard guest room at Disney's Polynesian Village Resort, with two queen beds, a floral wall mural, and a lanai looking out to palms.

pool.alt: The Lava Pool at Disney's Polynesian Village Resort, with its rock volcano, waterfall, and umbrellas along the deck.

name: Disney's Wilderness Lodge
theme: A grand national park lodge with a towering lobby, set in the woods on Bay Lake.
transport: Boat to Magic Kingdom
Buses to Epcot, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe resort in the Magic Kingdom area, on Bay Lake. This guide covers the hotel rooms at the lodge. In 2026 a Resort View room ran about $573 to $1,052 a night at full price, tax included. Water View rooms ran about $641 to $1,073, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Boat to Magic Kingdom. Official water transportation listings also show boats that connect Wilderness Lodge with the Contemporary and Fort Wilderness. Buses go to EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, Disney Springs and the water parks.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard hotel rooms are about 340 sq ft [verify] and sleep up to 4 adults with 2 queen beds, or up to 2 adults with 1 king bed. Views are Resort (landscape, trees, rooftop or parking), Water (pool, waterfall, Bay Lake or Copper Creek) or Fireworks (a partial view of Magic Kingdom fireworks). Club Level includes lounge access, and Deluxe Club Level rooms are larger and sleep up to 6.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families who want a boat to Magic Kingdom and a quieter, wooded setting. Whispering Canyon Cafe and Story Book Dining at Artist Point with Snow White are on site. It is not the pick if you need a fifth bed in a standard room, or if a monorail from the hotel is the main reason you're booking a Magic Kingdom resort.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Whispering Canyon Cafe serves brunch and dinner. Story Book Dining at Artist Point is the character dinner with Snow White. Roaring Fork is the quick-service restaurant, and Geyser Point Bar & Grill sits by the main pool, looking toward Bay Lake.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Copper Creek Springs Pool is the main pool, with a 67-foot slide built into the rocks, hot and cold whirlpool spas, and a children's play area. Guests can also use Boulder Ridge Cove Pool at the Boulder Ridge Villas, a quieter zero-entry pool with a whirlpool spa.

heads: Disney has listed exterior renovation work at Wilderness Lodge and Copper Creek Villas & Cabins through late 2026. Views may be affected, most amenities were planned to stay available, and you may see or hear work during the day. [verify if this work is still underway]

hero.alt: The waterfall and rockwork in front of Disney's Wilderness Lodge, with guest-room balconies rising above the pines.

name: Disney's Yacht Club Resort

author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Walking path and Friendship boats to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios. The EPCOT Skyliner station is a walk through the International Gateway. Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Resort View and Water View rooms sleep up to 5, about 400 sq ft [verify]. Club Level rooms include lounge access. Confirm the bed setup if you need a day bed. Suites, including turret rooms, are also offered.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Anyone who wants to walk or boat to EPCOT or Hollywood Studios, with Yachtsman Steakhouse and Ale & Compass in the hotel. A weaker pick if Magic Kingdom is your main park, or if you want Beach Club's Deluxe Room that sleeps six.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Ale & Compass Restaurant, Yachtsman Steakhouse and The Market at Ale & Compass, plus Cape May Cafe and Beaches & Cream at Beach Club next door.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Stormalong Bay is the shared main pool. There are also 3 leisure pools, including one at Beach Club Villas that official pages say Yacht Club guests may use.

heads: Official pages say the Skyliner will be closed for routine refurbishment January 24 through 30, 2027, and January 24 through February 2, 2028. Complimentary bus service will be available. Beach Club next door has visible exterior maintenance through late 2027.

name: Bay Lake Tower at Disney's Contemporary Resort

Buses to Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs. Boats also connect the Contemporary with Wilderness Lodge and Fort Wilderness.

quickFacts.value: Deluxe Studios sleep 4 (a queen and a double-size pull-down). One-bedroom villas sleep 5. Two-bedroom villas sleep 9. Grand Villas sleep 12. Resort View can mean parking or an obstructed view; Preferred is Bay Lake; Theme Park is Magic Kingdom. Room sizes were not confirmed on a current official page we opened [verify].

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families who want a walk or monorail to Magic Kingdom plus a kitchen, especially if a Theme Park View matters. A weaker pick if you need a fifth bed in a studio — Contemporary hotel rooms often sleep five, and these studios do not.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Shared with the Contemporary: Chef Mickey's, California Grill, Steakhouse 71 and Contempo Cafe. Disney's official site did not have a separate Bay Lake Tower dining page when we checked.

quickFacts.value: Tower guests use the Contemporary Feature Pool, with a 17-foot slide, and the quieter Bay Lake Pool. Whether the tower has a separate pool of its own is still unverified [verify].

heads: A May 2026 planDisney answer described refurbishment work in the Contemporary atrium, on the Main Tower exterior and at Bay Lake Tower, expected to continue through late 2027. Views and some outdoor travel may be affected, and guests may see or hear work during the day. [verify current status]

quickFacts.label: Category and price

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: A Disney Skyliner station is at the resort. The line runs directly to EPCOT's International Gateway. Hollywood Studios takes a transfer at Caribbean Beach. Buses serve Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: A Tower Studio is about 255 sq ft [verify] and sleeps 2, with a queen-size pull-down bed. One-, two- and three-bedroom villas are also on the rate sheet.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Anyone who wants a Skyliner ride to EPCOT or Hollywood Studios, and families who like having a character breakfast and a Signature dinner at Topolino's Terrace. A Tower Studio is a weaker pick if you need space for more than two people.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Topolino's Terrace is the rooftop restaurant, with a character breakfast and a Signature dinner. Primo Piatto is the quick-service spot. Le Petit Cafe is a lobby cafe. Bar Riva is the pool bar.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: The Riviera Pool is the family pool, with a slide that winds around a column tower and the S'il Vous Play water-play area. Beau Soleil Pool is the quieter pool. Towels are free at both.

heads: Disney Skyliner is scheduled to close for refurbishment from January 24 through January 30, 2027. Disney says complimentary bus service will be available during that week.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Stormalong Bay, plus leisure pools that include one at Beach Club Villas. Official Beach Club pages list three leisure pools in all.

heads: Official pages say Beach Club will have visible exterior maintenance through late 2027, which may impact some views and, at times, require alternate paths during daytime hours. The Skyliner is also closed January 24–30, 2027, and January 24–February 2, 2028, with buses filling in.

name: Disney's BoardWalk Villas
theme: Disney Vacation Club villas on the BoardWalk, sharing the building with the BoardWalk Inn.
transport: Walking paths and Friendship boats to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe Villa rooms in the BoardWalk complex. In 2026 a Deluxe Studio ran about $686 to $1,287 a night at full price, tax included, depending on the view. One-bedroom villas ran about $900 to $1,568, and Grand Villas about $3,016 to $5,383. The 2026 cash-rate table we used did not list a standalone two-bedroom category [verify current 2-bedroom cash availability].

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Walking paths and Friendship boats to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios. Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Deluxe Studios sleep 5. One-bedroom villas sleep 4. Grand Villas sleep 12. Room sizes were not confirmed on a current official page we opened [verify].

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families who want a kitchenette and a fifth bed in a studio on the BoardWalk, or groups who need a Grand Villa. A weaker pick if you need a fifth bed in a one-bedroom, or if you are staying mid-January through April 2027 and were counting on Luna Park Pool.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Shared with BoardWalk Inn and the promenade restaurants. Leaping Horse Libations is scheduled to close with Luna Park Pool from January 11 through April 2027.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Luna Park Pool, with a 200-foot slide, plus two leisure pools. Official pages say Luna Park, the Crazy Play Area and Leaping Horse Libations close January 11 through April 2027; the Villas Pool and the Inn Pool are planned to stay open.

heads: Official pages say the Luna Park Pool, the Luna Park Crazy Play Area and Leaping Horse Libations will close January 11, 2027, through April 2027 for routine maintenance. The Inn Pool and the Villas Pool are planned to stay open, and guests may see or hear work during the day.

name: The Cabins at Disney's Fort Wilderness Resort
theme: Disney Vacation Club cabins tucked into the woods at Fort Wilderness.
transport: Boat to Magic Kingdom
Internal buses around Fort Wilderness
Buses to Epcot, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe Villa cabins at Fort Wilderness, not campsites and not the old Moderate cabin product. In 2026 a 1 Bedroom Cabin ran about $526 to $1,041 a night at full price, tax included.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Internal bus around the resort, then a boat to Magic Kingdom. Official water-transportation listings also show boats that connect Fort Wilderness with the Contemporary and Wilderness Lodge. Buses to EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs, usually after an internal bus.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: One category: a 1 Bedroom Cabin that sleeps 6, with 1 queen, 1 queen-size pull-down and 1 bunk bed. There is no extra-adult charge up to that limit. Cabin size was not confirmed on a current official page we opened [verify].

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families of six who want a kitchen and a cabin in the woods, with a boat to Magic Kingdom. A weaker pick if you want to walk out to a monorail, or if a bunk bed does not work for your group.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Trail's End Restaurant, listed on Disney's official page with hours of 7:30 a.m. to 9:45 p.m. when we checked, and Meadow Snack Bar, an official quick-service kiosk. Confirm any other campground food stands before you go [verify the full current dining list].

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Cabin guests use the Fort Wilderness pools, including the Meadow Swimmin' Pool area. Official pool pages we tried did not load a full description [verify current pool names and features].

heads: These cabins are the current Disney Vacation Club cabin product at Fort Wilderness. Official pool details after work at the Meadow earlier in 2026 were not on a page we could fully load. [verify current pool status]

name: Disney's Fort Wilderness Resort & Campground
theme: Wooded campsites for tents and RVs on Bay Lake, with trails, horses and campfire evenings.
transport: Boat to Magic Kingdom
Internal buses around Fort Wilderness
Buses to Epcot, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Campground on Bay Lake, not a hotel. In 2026 a tent or pop-up site ran about $82 to $222 a night at full price, tax included. Full Hook-Up ran about $125 to $271, Preferred about $138 to $297, Premium about $148 to $313, and Premium Meadow about $156 to $348.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Internal bus around the resort, then a boat to Magic Kingdom. Official water-transportation listings also show boats that connect Fort Wilderness with the Contemporary and Wilderness Lodge. Buses to EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, the water parks and Disney Springs, usually after an internal bus.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Campsites, not hotel rooms. Every 2026 category is listed as sleeping up to 8 adults, with no extra-adult charge up to that limit. Pad sizes range from 10 by 25 feet on tent or pop-up sites to 18 by 60 feet on Premium and Premium Meadow sites. Preferred sites are listed as closer to the marina.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: People who already camp or travel with an RV and want official Disney resort transportation, including a boat to Magic Kingdom. A weaker pick if you want a hotel room — look at the cabins page instead — or if you dislike internal buses.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Trail's End Restaurant, listed on Disney's official page with hours of 7:30 a.m. to 9:45 p.m. when we checked, and Meadow Snack Bar, an official quick-service kiosk. Confirm any other campground food stands before you go [verify the full current dining list].

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: The Meadow Swimmin' Pool area is the main pool complex. Official pool pages we tried did not load a full description [verify current pool names and features].

heads: Recent reports described work at the Meadow Swimmin' Pool earlier in 2026. Official pool pages we tried did not load a full current description. [verify current pool status]
